name: millionaire-city-private-server
description: Millionaire City (TypeScript rewrite): game server, web client and desktop packaging
author: Millionaire City Revival contributors

scripts.dev:desktop: npm --prefix tools/app ci && npm --prefix tools/app run start
scripts.build:client: npm run build -w @mcity/shared && npm run build -w @mcity/client
scripts.start: npm run build:client && npm run dev:server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mcity/client && npm run test -w @mcity/server && npm run test -w @mcity/rules
